title: Armed Journey to the Song Dynasty
description: An AI-generated historical time-travel microdrama (持械入宋) following a five-person modern tactical team unexpectedly transported to the final years of the Northern Song dynasty, carrying contemporary weapons, medical knowledge, and engineering skills.
descriptionMore: Stranded along the empire's troubled frontier, the team works to defend villages, organize local forces, and survive amid shifting wartime alliances. The 100-episode first season is reportedly the opening chapter of a planned ten-season, roughly 1,000-episode franchise; Beijing Daily reported more than 12 billion cumulative views across the web for the project as of November 8, 2026.
